_doc: PRESENT few-shots (owner B). Corpus entries outside the 7 live cards; retrieved by signature overlap. The model reads them; nothing here is displayed or used by code to decide.

options.shows: One row per day starting today, today highlighted
Table with columns Day, High, Low, Forecast

shots.why: each day was asked; rows keyed by day with today first answer it directly

shots.ask: what languages is this repo written in

options.shows: Table with columns Language, Bytes, Share
Bars of Share per item, as shares of the whole

shots.why: parts of one whole read best as shares

shots.ask: compare AAPL MSFT GOOG over the last month

options.shows: Close over time as a line chart with one line per series

shots.why: over the last month asks for the trend of each item

shots.ask: when do the Braves play next

options.shows: List in time order with a now line
The next upcoming event with its time and a live countdown

shots.why: one question about the next event: show that event large

options.shows: Status list: the worst first, a calm line when all is fine

shots.why: a yes/no health question: problems first, healthy lines summarised

options.shows: The passage itself, clamped to the card

shots.why: the only option; it shows the text

shots.ask: cheapest hour to charge this week

options.shows: Price over time as a line chart
A day by hour grid shaded from low to high, with the best hour named

shots.why: cheapest hour over a week: name the minimum and show every day's hours

options.shows: Bars of Pts per item, largest first
Table with columns #, Team, P, W, D, L, Pts

shots.why: a league table is read by its columns
